description: Manage Datadog Service Level Objectives. Actions: list (with SLI status & error budget), get, create, update, delete, history. SLO types: metric-based, monitor-based. Each list/get/create/update response includes a `url` field deep-linking to the Datadog UI. Use for: reliability tracking, error budgets, SLA compliance, performance targets.

config.description: SLO configuration (for create/update). Must include type, name, thresholds.

from.description: Start time for history (ISO 8601 or relative like "7d", "1w")

ids.description: Multiple SLO IDs (for list with specific IDs)

limit.description: Maximum number of SLOs to return (default: 50)

to.description: End time for history (ISO 8601 or relative, default: now)

name: slos
